facts.text: The user is interested in how technology has influenced the development of contemporary sculpture.
The user wants examples of contemporary sculptors who embrace digital technologies in their work.
The user thinks technology has opened up new avenues for sculptors to explore.
The user is concerned that technological influence on contemporary sculpture may have downsides.
The user believes artists should balance technical aspects with artistic vision and meaning.
The user thinks there may be benefits to traditional sculptural techniques that are being lost in the age of technology.
The user worries that contemporary sculpture might lose some charm if artists become too reliant on technology.
The user believes traditional techniques can create a certain magic through imperfections and idiosyncrasies.
The user thinks there is satisfaction in creating sculptures through traditional techniques.
The user believes satisfaction from traditional sculpting can come from spending hours or days alone carving, shaping, or welding a piece.
The user believes a bond with the sculpture developed through traditional making might not be the same if the sculpture is created digitally.
The user agrees that there is something special about the tactile experience of creating art with hands.
The user asks whether traditional sculptural techniques might become more valued as people long for tangible experiences in an increasingly digital world.

keyphrases: balance technical aspects with artistic vision
